prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
engine_stated_criteria: recent seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for all of Miami—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, and price range. Based on the available rankings, **Sandra Rathe of REAL** is a reasonable first person to interview: HomeLight lists her first among its Miami agents, with a 5.0 rating and 132 reviews. **Desare Kohn-Laski** and **Dominick Martinez** also appear near the top of that ranking.

Treat rankings as a shortlist, not a guarantee. Before choosing, ask each agent for **recent seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range**, their typical sale-to-list price and time on market, a pricing plan, marketing examples, and their commission and contract terms. Compare at least three proposals; a strong local track record matters more than a citywide ranking.

[HomeLight’s Miami agent ranking](https://www.homelight.com/miami-fl/top-real-estate-agents) · [Realtor.com’s Miami agent directory](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/Miami_FL)

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, home type, and approximate value, I can help narrow the shortlist.
